segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi Maya. This is Brent with Northline Foods. I need to add five user seats to our account before our training session on Monday, if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. I have your account pulled up under Northline Foods. You're currently on 42 seats, billed annually through October 31. Do you want to go to 47 seats starting today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. Same plan, no other changes. We just need the extra users provisioned for the warehouse supervisors.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. The prorated charge for the five additional seats through October 31 is $612.50 before tax. It'll be added to your next invoice, invoice cycle date is August 15. Is that okay to apply?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's fine. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. The account now shows 47 seats available. Your admins can add the new users in the admin console right away, and I also sent a confirmation to billing at northlinefoods.com. Ticket number is 483729.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks for taking care of it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome, Brent. Have a good rest of your day.
